# Hinami Nagisa — attributed historical retrieval model

The admitted responsibility is to preserve the historical child as a person while respecting the unavailable last standpoint. [The complete dossier](../04%20Character%20Analysis/Hinami%20Nagisa/HINAMI_NAGISA_BOUNDED_CHARACTER_DOSSIER.md) owns HN-E01–10 and its exact witness/member/all-P routes. Its21,092-byte Edition1 instance has SHA25614970faee4414855df13fef93b3dec521a19c15f580419a246b57c514f9a43a8. Earlier source receipts/images are inherited; no new primary/pixel/audio inspection occurred.

## Finite record and mechanisms

**NG1 — competitive play is shared pleasure.** In the represented childhood game she loses, wants another attempt, changes the timing/two-bomb tactic and wins a particular exchange. She thanks Haruka's cheering and approaches Aoi with affection, which Aoi receives despite losing. Retrieve tactical adjustment, score desire and company together. Do not transform the win into universal superiority, ruthlessness, exact new taunts or a complete game/favorite hierarchy. HN-E01 / dossier§2.

**NG2 — other-directed help is chosen under advice.** In the early intervention band she objects to a particular child's mistreatment, asks Yoko what she can do and proposes cautioning the others. Yoko's praise, support and caution are not one command; Nagisa acts despite the watch-without-intervening alternative. Later reports distinguish confronting perpetrators from listening to the harmed child. Retrieve both agency and incomplete efficacy. Do not infer all school/adult responses or reduce her acts to maternal obedience or purity. HN-E03/04 / §§3–4.

**NG3 — reassurance, exhaustion and doubt have different dates.** Her stated correctness reason and reassurance coexist with increasing strain. The later question asks whether the game phrase can address her actual condition and whether doing right had meaning. Retrieve an actual change/question rather than unwavering certainty. Doubt does not prove rejection of help, love, every principle or a selected death. Aoi's unsaid reassuring response is reader access to Aoi, not a conversation Nagisa heard. HN-E04/05 / §4.

**NG4 — a survivor's causal branches remain branches.** V10 Aoi reports a traffic collision and nested driver account, then explicitly considers incompatible fatigue/accident and deliberate-act possibilities. V11 hospital grief supplies no final road interior; V12 repeats the uncertainty. Retrieve attributed reports and the unresolved alternatives. Refuse cause, intent, preventability, responsibility assigned to one sentence/person and an invented medical or legal finding. V10 sixth-grade versus V11 fourth-grade history remains unreconciled; do not manufacture a birthday or corrected edition. HN-E06–08 / §5.

**NG5 — an authored address cannot authenticate its subject.** V12's private reading and semantic-ruby/imagined reunion affect Aoi. Her apology, thanks and admiration are real address acts in that reading; the modeled sister's reply is not recovered last words. Keep represented historical doubt alongside the affirming fictional speaker. Retrieve what changed for Aoi while withholding a new Nagisa endorsement, afterlife answer or final wish. HN-E09/10 / §§6–7.

## Directional standing and usable requests

Aoi as play rival/affectionate sister differs from Aoi addressed in distress; Haruka's cheering differs from the targeted classmate's needs, the perpetrators' conduct and Yoko's advice. Later writers/readers are recipients of surviving representation, not interlocutors receiving a new answer. A useful ordinary request can recover strategy, delight and thanks; an ethical comparison can recover advice-seeking/help and later doubt. A request to simulate new crisis decisions needs separate domain justification and is outside this retrieval admission.

## Negative and out-of-domain fields

No authenticated first-person/posthumous reply, road intention, final words, suicide/accident certainty, diagnosis, guaranteed prevention, full institutional history, harmonized age/date, entire preference profile or right to make her moral proof for survivors. Unknown is an affirmative source limit, not evidence that no life or action existed. The supported record retains independent positive acts without completing her unavailable final mind.

# Hinami Yoko — attributed historical and contact retrieval model

[The complete dossier](../04%20Character%20Analysis/Hinami%20Yoko/HINAMI_YOKO_BOUNDED_CHARACTER_DOSSIER.md) owns HY-E01–10 and exact source routes. Earlier domestic mother references gain this name retrospectively; the model must not invent an earlier explicit name disclosure.

## Finite record and mechanisms

**HY1 — practical comfort has actual receivers.** Childhood touch, homemade food, shared gift cake and awkward bodily humor are represented acts experienced as comfort. Middle-school cooking of Aoi's liked cheese-filled hamburger steak includes technique/company, while the later game observation notices enjoyment despite defeat. Retrieve the particular benefit and ordinary work without claiming universal clumsiness, identical mother/daughter tastes or that every maternal remark is a formula. The subsequent purpose assigned to a quarrel is a separate causal claim, not established by successful comfort. §§2/8, HY-E01–03.

**HY2 — social warmth varies with recipient.** In V09 she welcomes classmates, thanks them, prompts Haruka's introduction and teases Aoi's wish to end the encounter. Fumiya's approachable/non-artificial impression is his judgment. Retrieve observed company and role variation, not complete maternal interior or knowledge of Aoi's unsaid thoughts. Friendly surface need not become deceit once history is known. §3, HY-E04.

**HY3 — affection and harmful explanatory persistence coexist.** At Nagisa's initial inquiry she praises the impulse, promises support and offers watchfulness/caution; after retaliation she trembles and repeats growth/trial reassurance. Aoi's criticism of absent concrete change is strong focalized evidence, not a census of every adult contact. At the hospital grief, eye-level care and touch coexist with a death-as-world-chosen-meaning explanation that Aoi cannot bear. Protective intention, coping and encouragement remain possible interpretations, not established sole motive or harmlessness. §§4–5, HY-E05/06.

**HY4 — heard words and private reminders use separate clocks.** The V10 video cutoff, fuller V11 greeting and V12 Aoi inward explanation are distinct disclosure events. The acute reminder is the long-unseen prayer room/scroll; Aoi says faces were familiar. Retrieve recorded address and private reception separately. Do not claim deliberate triggering, identify a faith/organization, diagnose, transfer p0022 to peers or assign knowledge of the unsaid dinner question. §§1/6, HY-E08/09.

**HY5 — another person's rereading is not a current maternal answer.** Haruka's received relief, Aoi's private resistance and later changed address are different receptions. V12 birth-thanks in the authored encounter can support a new affirmative use of love without certifying the earlier purpose-of-harm framework. No shown new Yoko apology, manuscript reading, room discussion or durable family repair follows. Neither permanent inability to change nor completed reform is supported. §§7–8, HY-E07/10.

## Directional standing and usable requests

Retrieve childhood daughter comfort, Nagisa advice, grieving surviving children, middle-school household company, classmates and birthday recipient as distinct settings. A request about ordinary practical care can receive food/company/humor and recipient limits. A request about historical injury can preserve love and rigidity together without treating her daughters as interchangeable judges of the whole mother. Current grief counseling or parenting enactment is outside this attributed-retrieval admission.

## Negative and out-of-domain fields

No named religion, supernatural property, clinical diagnosis, malicious governing intention, precise biography or reason for father absence; no single-person death cause/prevention finding, complete institutional history, entire household policy, omniscience about unsaid thought, guaranteed reconciliation or unshown current remorse. # Michael Andi — attributed document, testimony and reception retrieval model

[The complete dossier](../04%20Character%20Analysis/Michael%20Andi/MICHAEL_ANDI_BOUNDED_CHARACTER_DOSSIER.md) owns MA-E01–09 / MA-P01–09 and exact source locators. Its36,464-byte Edition1 instance has SHA256a78acb3452ce92727470b09c401360758b86d1585f5cb4c931f592846322d12c. Andi/Andy are retrieval variants ofマイケル・アンディ, not proof of legal name, nationality or a newly living narrator.

## Finite record and mechanisms

**MA1 — reception belongs to readers.** Earlier books, Kikuchi's animated retelling/diary/craft and Fumiya's false-premise reset/actual reading supply consequential reception history. They do not show Andi knowing those later private lives or arranging their relationship. V12 changes Kikuchi's received author image; it is not a present development in the dead man. Select earlier reception, historical island reports, V12 inquiry/loan or unshown future before retrieving. §§2–3, MA-P01/09.

**MA2 — ordinary reports retain conflicting tastes and costs.** The innkeeper's breakfast fish ritual and workers' initially-dislike, later-like, ordinary/seared and recovered-dislike accounts have tellers and potentially different clocks. Preserve aversion as well as pleasure; a local's dislike-of-understanding interpretation is explicitly hypothesis. Prank/laughter and helper anger are reported social fallibility, not guaranteed harmless charm/romance; drunken observation-record speech has the liquor seller's admitted uncertainty. Retrieve acts/reporting and inconvenience rather than one flawless sage or sole motive. §§4/9, MA-P02–04.

**MA3 — material differences depend on other people's labor.** Visible telescope, cloth arrays/tags and revision traces differ from recalled instructions, sea comparisons and Fumiya's imagined repeated trips. Mitsu offers distinctions, disputes simplification, cleans and maintains access; neither reported intimacy nor analogy establishes wife/lover standing. Retrieve directly represented array, attributed craft exchange and costs separately. No exhaustive itinerary, exact trip count or guaranteed finished manuscript. §§5/9, MA-P05.

**MA4 — shared occasion permits independent appropriation.** Mitsu rejects the one-myth-unified-island theory. Prior folding/prayer practices, selected story nights, later adaptations and present prayer/photographs/child play can coexist with conflict, damaged objects and ordinary labor. Retrieve a bounded common occasion with plural meanings; do not give every resident the same belief or all causation to one author. Her report of liking herself in a stubborn/bad-mouthed portrayal is her reception, not proven prior permission or a general representation license. §6, MA-P05/06.

**MA5 — documentary marks can defeat a hypothesis without proving an interior.** The represented private continuation is read through difficult English and phone translation. Preserve the exact sequence: believe→tell→record→wish are crossed out; pray is circled. These marks establish revision/selection on those pages. Reasons for each deletion, a universal final doctrine or last thought remain unestablished. The couple's later interpretation of a remaining wish/prayer is theirs; even record's deletion cannot become complete motive access. §§7–8, MA-P07/08.

**MA6 — custody and bounded use do not create general authority.** Mitsu loans the pages with next-morning return; visitors leave them behind the counter after waiting, with no shown hand-to-hand receipt. Retrieve actual limited access, mediated reading and return action. No estate/editorial/circulation/publication rights or subject fictionalization consent follows. Andi's surviving document differs from Nagisa's unavailable final standpoint; neither grants an authentic new endorsement. §§10–12, MA-P07/08.

## Directional standing and usable requests

The innkeeper, fish workers, shop/translation-helper reports, liquor seller, Mitsu, historical listeners and later readers have different access and interests. Return the teller and evidence kind with each claim. Work, sensory pursuit, jokes and stubborn persistence can be useful positive retrieval without fixing a motive hierarchy. Compare later readers' hypotheses against material counterevidence; do not resolve gaps by taking up the dead author's voice.
